nodes.title: COFFE
widgets_values:
# Generation Mode: T2VA

Video duration: 5 seconds, 9:16 vertical, high-quality family-friendly stylized 3D CG office comedy.

Character consistency: A coffee-cup-sized baby dragon with emerald-green scales, a cream-colored belly, large amber eyes, tiny rounded horns, small wings, clumsy claws, and an oversized blue employee ID badge. An adult orange tabby cat supervisor wears a charcoal-gray suit, white shirt, and burgundy tie, maintaining a calm, serious expression throughout.

integrated_multimodal_description:

[Shot 1] 0.00–1.50s

A bright, modern open-plan office with light wood desks, glass partitions, green plants, and soft cool-white lighting. Medium shot. The tiny dragon walks confidently into the center of the frame, trying to look professional. Its oversized employee badge swings wildly. Suddenly, a puff of gray smoke escapes its nostrils, and the dragon freezes in embarrassment, quickly fanning the smoke away with both claws.

[Shot 2] 1.50–3.20s

Hard cut to the office break room. The dragon holds a slice of bread and attempts to toast it with a tiny burst of fire from its mouth. The flame suddenly grows too large, instantly turning the bread into black charcoal. Startled, the dragon hides the smoking bread behind its back as a red smoke detector flashes in the background. A thin trail of smoke rises over its head.

[Shot 3] 3.20–5.00s

Hard cut to the dragon standing nervously in front of the orange tabby cat supervisor's desk. The dragon lowers its head and closes its eyes, expecting punishment. The expressionless cat calmly slides a small red fire extinguisher across the desk toward it. The dragon opens one eye, looks at the extinguisher, then gives an awkward little salute. A tiny puff of smoke forms a question mark above its head as the cat slowly blinks. End on this funny, heartwarming visual.

Visual style: Rounded, adorable 3D characters, detailed scales and fur, soft volumetric lighting, expressive facial animation, believable physical reactions, smooth camera movements, and clear comedic timing. Maintain identical character designs, proportions, clothing, and lighting across all shots.

overall_soundscape: Soft office ambience, tiny footsteps, a badge rattling, a short fiery whoosh, a faint smoke alarm beep, a fire extinguisher sliding across the desk, and a subtle comedic closing sound effect.

non_diegetic_music: N/A. No background music.

Restrictions: No dialogue, no lip-sync, no subtitles, no readable text, no UI, no watermarks, no logos, and no corner badges. No readable text on computer screens or office props. Retain only environmental sounds and sound effects.

nodes.title: The Tiny Chef's Pancake Disaster
widgets_values:
**Generation Mode:** T2VA

**Video duration:** 5 seconds, 9:16 vertical, high-quality family-friendly stylized 3D CG cooking comedy.

**Character consistency:** A tiny emerald-green baby dragon with a cream belly, large amber eyes, tiny rounded horns, small wings, and an oversized white chef hat. A giant golden pancake in a miniature home kitchen.

**integrated_multimodal_description:**

[Shot 1] 0.00–1.40s

In a bright miniature kitchen, the baby dragon stands on a wooden stool beside a frying pan. It grips a spatula with both claws and struggles to lift an enormous golden pancake nearly twice its size. Butter sizzles while the dragon narrows its eyes with exaggerated determination.

[Shot 2] 1.40–3.30s

Hard cut to a dramatic low-angle close-up. The dragon launches the pancake into the air with an overconfident flip. The pancake rises far too high, slowly rotates above the dragon, and begins descending. The dragon looks straight up, mouth open, tiny arms frozen in panic.

[Shot 3] 3.30–5.00s

The pancake lands perfectly on the dragon's head, covering its chef hat like a giant golden helmet. A single blueberry drops from above and lands precisely in the center. The dragon blinks through a small gap, then proudly poses like a professional chef as a puff of steam rises.

nodes.title: . The Cat's Impossible Mirror Selfie
widgets_values:
**Generation Mode:** T2VA

**Video duration:** 5 seconds, 9:16 vertical, high-quality family-friendly stylized 3D CG pet comedy.

**Character consistency:** A fluffy orange tabby cat with cream-colored paws, large green eyes, a pink nose, and oversized black sunglasses. The cat stands in a stylish apartment in front of a tall, spotless mirror.

**integrated_multimodal_description:**

[Shot 1] 0.00–1.40s

The orange tabby cat stands confidently before a full-length mirror in a sunlit apartment. It tilts its head, adjusts its oversized sunglasses with one paw, and raises a smartphone for the perfect selfie. Slow cinematic push-in as the cat strikes an exaggerated influencer pose.

[Shot 2] 1.40–3.30s

Hard cut to an over-the-shoulder mirror shot. The cat dramatically lifts its chin and stretches one paw outward. A tiny feather stuck to its forehead becomes visible in the reflection. The cat freezes, slowly crosses its eyes to inspect the feather, and attempts to swipe it away, accidentally smearing its nose against the glass.

[Shot 3] 3.30–5.00s

The cat backs away, shakes its head, and confidently poses again. Its sunglasses suddenly slide down its nose, revealing enormous confused green eyes. The cat gives a tiny accidental sneeze, sending the feather floating onto its nose. It stares at its reflection in complete disbelief.

**Visual style:** High-quality stylized 3D fur, expressive feline eyes, soft natural window light, reflective glass, cinematic close-ups, subtle physical comedy, smooth camera movement, consistent character design.

nodes.title: The Baby Dragon Rescues a Tiny Kitten
widgets_values:
**Generation Mode:** T2VA

**Video duration:** 5 seconds, 9:16 vertical, high-quality family-friendly stylized 3D CG heartwarming comedy.

**Character consistency:** A coffee-cup-sized baby dragon with emerald-green scales, a cream-colored belly, large amber eyes, tiny rounded horns, little wings, and a small blue scarf. A fluffy orange kitten with white paws, oversized blue eyes, and a soft pink nose.

**integrated_multimodal_description:**

[Shot 1] 0.00–1.40s

In a tiny garden just after the rain, a fluffy orange kitten sits in the middle of a shallow puddle, frightened by the water surrounding its paws. The baby dragon approaches, notices the kitten trembling, and immediately puffs out its chest with heroic determination. Raindrops glisten on leaves around them.

[Shot 2] 1.40–3.30s

The dragon spreads its tiny wings and tries to lift the kitten out of the puddle. It strains, wobbles, and briefly slips on the wet stones. With one final effort, it manages to pull the kitten onto a dry patch of moss. Both characters tumble gently into a pile of soft leaves.

[Shot 3] 3.30–5.00s

The kitten nuzzles the dragon's cheek and curls its tail around the dragon's tiny body. The dragon smiles proudly, then attempts a heroic pose, only to sneeze a miniature puff of harmless sparkling smoke that makes the kitten's ears pop upright. They look at each other in surprise before cuddling together as warm sunlight breaks through the clouds.

**Visual style:** Adorable cinematic 3D animation, finely detailed scales and fluffy fur, expressive eyes, soft rainy reflections, warm volumetric sunlight, believable gentle physics, smooth close-up camera movement, consistent character proportions, emotionally satisfying ending.

**overall_soundscape:** Gentle rain dripping from leaves, tiny splashes, quick wing flutters, soft leaf rustling, a kitten purr, a tiny sneeze, and a subtle sparkling sound effect.
